card.name: Dosage form word used as a modifier
card.fires_on: The dosage-form word (tablets, capsules, injection, solution) right after a full drug name, when it is used as a modifier before a noun like dose, treatment, administration or clinical studies.

modes.label: Form word before dose
modes.description: Tablets or capsules after a drug name, followed by the word dose.
modes.example: it is recommended not to exceed a single 2.5 mg vardenafil hydrochloride<< tablets>> dose in a 72-hour period

modes.label: Form word before administration or studies
modes.description: Injection, solution or tablets after a drug name, followed by administration, treatment or studies.
modes.example: Prior to Neostigmine Methylsulfate<< Injection>> administration and up until complete recovery of normal
